title: apply_patch
description: Input schema for the litany built-in `apply_patch` tool (ARCH §3.3 *The patch tool*). The harness sends this verbatim as the `input_schema` field of the tool's entry in the model request's `tools: [...]` array.

input.description: One patch envelope: starts with '*** Begin Patch', ends with '*** End Patch', and carries any number of '*** Add File: <path>', '*** Delete File: <path>', and '*** Update File: <path>' sections (an update may be followed by '*** Move to: <path>'). Update hunks use ' ' context, '-' removal, '+' addition lines; '@@' separates hunks, '@@ <enclosing symbol>' anchors a hunk inside a repeated block, '*** End of File' pins a hunk to the end of the file. Paths resolve against the current working directory.
